content_sections.heading: HLL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is post-specific: only Indian Nationals may apply, and candidates must meet the essential qualification and minimum post-qualification experience laid down for the post they are applying to. SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India directives, subject to submission of the applicable certificate (SC/ST Caste Certificate, or OBC Non-Creamy Layer Certificate, in the Government of India prescribed format). Candidates already employed in Government, Semi-Government, PSU, or Autonomous Bodies must submit a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the time of interview. The maximum age for each post is calculated as on 01 August 2026, which is also the cut-off date used for qualification and post-qualification experience. In addition to the post-specific relaxation above, SC/ST/OBC/PwD candidates are eligible for age relaxation as per Government of India directives. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: HLL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The notification indicates selection is carried out through an interview with document verification; it does not describe a separate written examination stage. Broadly, the process includes: Screening of applications against the essential qualification, experience and age criteria for the post applied to Interview of eligible candidates, at which all information submitted in the application is verified against original documents Submission of a No Objection Certificate (NOC) at the interview, for candidates currently employed in Government, Semi-Government, PSU or Autonomous Bodies Final selection decision, which rests with HLL Management and is stated to be final If any information provided by a candidate is found to be false, incorrect, or not in conformity with the eligibility criteria, the candidature is liable to be rejected or cancelled at any stage of the recruitment process. HLL also reserves the right to cancel, restrict or modify the selection process, or to not fill any or all of the posts notified, and the number of vacancies may be increased or decreased based on organizational requirements.

content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online through a Google Form. The official notification references this as a "Click here to Apply" hyperlink; the underlying URL is not specified in the extracted text of the document, so candidates should refer to the official HLL website or the original notification PDF for the working link. The application steps are as follows: Access the Google Form using the apply link provided in the official notification Download the prescribed job application form from the link provided in the form, or from the HLL website Fill in the application form digitally and save it as a PDF or Word file; handwritten applications will not be accepted Upload the completed application form using the file upload option in the Google Form (maximum upload size: 10 MB per file) Attach additional supporting documents in PDF or Word format if required – CV, educational/experience certificates, latest salary slip – ensuring each file is under 10 MB Select the correct post applied for in the form, to ensure proper processing Submit the form on or before the deadline; late submissions will not be considered Job title and Reference Code should be clearly mentioned in the application form. Applications not in the prescribed format will not be considered for the selection process, and no separate communication will be sent regarding such rejections.

faq.question: Q1. What is HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by HLL Lifecare Limited, a Mini Ratna Central Public Sector Enterprise, for 16 posts (Reference Codes HLL/HR/061/2026 to HLL/HR/076/2026) spanning Mental Health & Wellness, Lifepath, Allied Healthcare, Consumer Goods, Learning & Development, Legal, Pharma Retail, IT, HR, Secretarial, Civil and Finance functions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 16 posts advertised, each with 1 position, for a total of 16 vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The revised last date for submission of applications is 23 September 2026. Applications opened on 18 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Qualification differs by post – ranging from a full-time LL.B. (Manager – Legal) and CA/CMA (Finance and CFO posts) to MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing or Operations, B.Tech/B.E. in Civil or IT, B.Pharm with MBA, and ACS (Secretarial). Refer to the qualification table above for the post you are interested in.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Maximum age varies from 40 years (Manager – Legal) to 52 years (Vice President posts, relaxable up to 57 years based on excess experience). See the age limit table above for post-wise details.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications are submitted through a Google Form, by downloading and filling the prescribed application form digitally, uploading it along with supporting documents, and selecting the correct post before submission. No offline or handwritten applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for HLL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through screening of applications, an interview with document verification, and a final decision by HLL Management. No separate written examination is mentioned in the notification.
